description: Bootstrap must infer a reasonable document-language default ask the user to confirm it once and persist the result before generating durable project knowledge. Existing initialized projects without the field must receive a non-translating migration path.
acceptance_criteria: Bootstrap confirms document_language before creating Product or Feature natural-language content
The confirmed value is stored in docs/methodology-config.json
An existing project without the field is asked once and its current documents are not automatically translated
Changing conversation language does not modify the stored document_language
